dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the visible posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical compression on the left lateral margin compared to the more uniformly convex right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white; characterized by a strong lateral lighting gradient with high-intensity luminance on the left side and lower-intensity blue-grey shading on the right.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single high-contrast dark circular aperture (blowhole) at the anterior apex; multiple fine, faint linear low-contrast marks visible on the posterior right dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct fine linear white scar visible on the posterior-right quadrant of the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dorsal ridge appearing as a sharp longitudinal contrast boundary between the illuminated and shadowed halves of the dorsal plane.
